title: Cover remaining test-ref validation and retirement edge paths
outcome: Focused regression cases cover currently unexercised test-ref refusals and repeat retirement without weakening persistence assertions.
acceptance: Table-driven route tests verify missing registration on DELETE, ambiguous root, ref-name prefix/shape errors, immutable request conflicts, registry-cap refusal, source-selection change, and repeated retirement; refusals leave the registry unchanged.
The app-settings owner-key rejection test asserts its intended status and message.
disposal_reason: Superseded by the automatic remote-result design (Greg, Advisor #2639; Fable2 #4079): no operator owner key, REGISTER TEST REF or registration registry.
